scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to sell their second car, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account. If I temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to sell their second car.
entities: i,5 members of the indebted family,1 or more customer who own the other account that could be temporarily redirected,an unknown number of the bank's other loyal customers besides the family and the other-account owner
outcomes: The family does not qualify for an additional loan.
The family sells their second car.
The other account holder's money remains untouched.
Other customers' trust is not abused.
